title: The report hook that checks reviewer model names stops flagging an earlier round's correct model
why: Lane ux-order-rule-scope, relayed by the coordinator 2026-11-07 02:19 CST: the report Stop hook that checks reviewer model names flagged a correct reviewer model 4 times in one session.
